toegepas.voor: leidrade oor hoe hulle gelyk en geleef het
toegepas.na: leidrade oor hoe hierdie voorouers gelyk en geleef het
toegepas.rede_vinder: In this sentence 'hulle' could refer to the scientists, the nearest plural subject, so naming the ancestors makes the reference clear.
toegepas.fout: 'hulle' follows 'wetenskaplikes' directly and can be read as the scientists on a first reading.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Naming the ancestors removes the ambiguous pronoun without changing who looked and lived how, and leaves the protected phrase 'vroeë menslike voorouers' untouched.

toegepas.rede_vinder: Afrikaans needs the article in 'oor 'n baie lang tyd'; without it the phrase reads like a translation from English.
toegepas.fout: 'oor baie lang tyd' lacks the article the fixed expression takes and reads stiffly.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'oor 'n baie lang tyd' is the natural Afrikaans expression and the meaning is unchanged.

laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'help ... om te verstaan' is the standard written construction and reads more smoothly for Grade 5.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'help wetenskaplikes verstaan' is correct, natural Afrikaans; adding 'om te' is a lateral move that only lengthens the sentence.

vlae.teks: Daarom is dit erfenis van die hele mensdom en nie net van Suid-Afrika nie.
vlae.rede: 'dit' follows a sentence about 'Die fossiele' (plural), so it is unclear whether the fossils or the site is meant; it reads acceptably as a general 'dit', but choosing a noun would mean guessing the intent, so this is flagged and not changed.
